stories.summary: China's ambassador made a rare intervention after New Zealand Foreign Minister Winston Peters refused to back down over remarks he made in parliament to Chinese-born MP Lawrence Xu-Nan.

stories.title: Hundreds evacuated as wildfires sweep Turkey's western and southern coasts
stories.summary: Active fires in Antalya's Kaş district and Muğla province forced evacuations and highway closures as extreme heat fanned blazes across six provinces.

stories.title: Nicaraguan leader proposes extending presidential term by another year
stories.summary: It is not the first time the constitution has been amended to allow Daniel Ortega, 80, to stay in power for longer.

stories.title: Watch: Giant iceberg turns over near Greenland's coast
stories.summary: Video captured by a passerby showed the moment the iceberg collapsed, creating a big wave.

stories.title: Crete wildfire kills two firefighters as fierce flames spread in Greece
stories.summary: Wildfires continue to burn across Crete, Greece, where two firefighters died as strong winds fuelled the blaze and aircraft joined rescue efforts.

stories.title: Seven dead after helicopter crashes during firefighting mission in Argentina
stories.summary: Seven people, including four senior officials from San Juan, were killed when a Bell 412 helicopter crashed during wildfire training en route to La Rioja.

stories.title: Japan shopping mall explosion after 7.1 quake captured on dashcam footage
stories.summary: Dashcam footage shows a shopping mall explosion after a 7.1-magnitude earthquake hit Kumamoto, Japan, as rescuers search for survivors.

stories.title: Cyanide in tomato pesticide killed 15 elephants, Kenyan officials suspect
stories.summary: Foul play is ruled out in the record number of elephant deaths for decades in this area of southern Kenya.

stories.title: EU's competition chief Ribera slams climate deniers as fires rage: 'They are lying'
stories.summary: In her interview with Euronews, Ribera took aim at 'dangerous and stupid' European politicians who cast doubt on climate science and dismiss environmental policies as ideological rather than grounded in evidence.

stories.title: Dashcam captures tornado toppling power lines onto car
stories.summary: Video obtained by the BBC provides a firsthand look at the powerful storm system that ripped through parts of eastern Wisconsin on 27 July.

stories.title: At least five members of same family killed in Russian missile attack, Zelensky says
stories.summary: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

stories.title: Milei authorises expulsion of foreigners over anti-Argentina hate speech
stories.summary: The government said the changes were a response to what it described as "recent displays of hostility towards the Argentine Republic and Argentinians," although it did not cite specific examples.

stories.title: Man impaled by a hiking pole treks 10 miles down mountain
stories.summary: Instead of calling for a helicopter rescue, David Cifaldi hiked down Montana's Granite Peak with a hiking pole piercing his side.

stories.title: Thousands evacuated in Crete as wildfires threaten tourist resorts
stories.summary: Strong winds have fanned the flames in the Rethymno region as wildfires continue to ravage the Greek island.

stories.title: Europe wants to be a strong partner of the US in the Moon race, ESA astronaut says
stories.summary: Italian astronaut Luca Parmitano will pilot the Artemis III mission, NASA's next step towards its first Moon landing in decades. He tells Euronews how he is preparing, his thoughts on the space race and what European aspects he’ll bring into orbit.

stories.title: Uefa to boycott World Cups if Fifa plans approved
stories.summary: Uefa says "the World Cup is not for sale" after its 55 member associations vote to boycott future tournaments if Fifa and its president, Gianni Infantino, do not back down on their investment proposals.

stories.title: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
stories.summary: Iran may believe it can control its conflict carefully enough to keep pressure on the US while avoiding an all-out war.

stories.title: Father of teen school shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison
stories.summary: "It is clear you failed as a parent," the judge told Colin Gray, who was found guilty earlier this year on charges stemming from the deadly 2024 school attack.

stories.title: India wants to join the strawberry superpowers
stories.summary: Indian strawberry farmers rely on varieties imported from the US and Europe, but that could change.

stories.title: Rescue teams face ‘race against time’ in search for trapped survivors as death toll in Japan rises to at least 13 – as it happened
stories.summary: Emergency workers are continuing their search for survivors in southern Japan after yesterday’s powerful earthquake ‘Race against time’: Japan earthquake death toll rises as rescue teams search for missing An aerial view of a collapsed section of a bridge in the city of Yatsushiro after an earthquake with a preliminary magnitude of 7.1 struck Japan’s southern Kumamoto prefecture: Japan’s Mainichi Shimbun newspaper has been speaking to people at the Nippon Paper Industries factory in Yatsushiro,

stories.title: Iraq eyes supplying Turkey with 1 million oil barrels a day amid Hormuz crisis
stories.summary: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Zeydi visited Ankara for his first talks with Erdoğan since taking office, offering to supply Turkey with 1 million barrels of oil per day as Ankara seeks to reduce its dependence on disrupted Gulf routes.

stories.title: Iran rejects Hormuz deal and launches surprise strike on US forces in Jordan
stories.summary: Tehran rejected an Omani proposal to divide the strait equally and declared Hormuz would "never return to its prewar situation," hours before the IRGC launched multiple ballistic missiles at US forces in Jordan in what CENTCOM called an attempted surprise attack.

stories.title: Houthis to copy Iran's Hormuz playbook with Red Sea toll plan
stories.summary: Yemen's information minister said intelligence confirmed IRGC advisers were directly involved in designing a Houthi-enforced toll system for the Bab el-Mandeb, mirroring Iran's contested claim to charge fees in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: The Chinese robot army transforming the UK's retail industry
stories.summary: Britain's weak productivity growth and labour shortages are creating an opportunity for China's robotics firms.

stories.title: ‘The shaking was terrifying’: stories of survival and loss emerge after Japan earthquake
stories.summary: Rescuers pulling people from the wreckage in southern Japan in a haunting repeat of disaster that struck 10 years ago ‘Race against time’: Japan earthquake death toll rises as rescue teams search for missing “There was a voice coming from the collapsed house, and I could see a hand,” Tomohide Nagata, a volunteer firefighter, told the Kumamoto Nichinichi Shimbun. “One of our senior members crawled in and pulled him out. stories.summary: In today’s newsletter: Across ​the country, a ​younger generation is turning private disillusionment into public defiance​ against a government that once felt untouchable Good morning. stories.title: India’s Cockroach movement threatens to restart protests after mass student arrests
stories.summary: Cockroach Janta party says government has broken promise, with detentions in Delhi, Assam, West Bengal and Bihar India’s youth-led “Cockroach” movement, whose nationwide protests forced the resignation of the education minister , has accused the government of backtracking on its promise not to act against student protesters and has threatened to restart demonstrations. stories.title: Germany: How weather extremes impact local agriculture
stories.summary: Heat, drought, heavy rain and late frosts are taking a toll on German farmers. They increasingly respond with adapted varieties, new crops, modern breeding techniques and modified farming methods.

stories.title: How two wars and El Nino could fuel world hunger
stories.summary: The wars in Ukraine and the Middle East haven't yet crippled global food supplies. Add a powerful weather pattern like El Nino, however, and the risks multiply.

stories.title: Germany: How effective are exit programs for Islamists?
stories.summary: Germany has set up many programs to help individuals break away from the radical Islamist scene. Following the Islamist terror attack on Berlin's Pride event, critics say the programs are ineffective.

stories.title: Bayreuth Festival opens with celebration and commemoration
stories.summary: To mark its 150th anniversary, the Bayreuth Festival remembers victims of the Holocaust — and confronts its founder's antisemitism.

stories.title: German Muslims are alarmed by the Islamist terror attack in Berlin
stories.summary: Germany's Muslim organizations condemn the Islamist terrorist attack targeting Berlin's Pride celebrations and fear repercussions.

stories.title: How well are LGBTQ+ rights protected across Europe?
stories.summary: After the attack on Berlin’s Pride event on Saturday, the situation of the LGBTQ+ community in Germany is a topic of conversation. How well are queer rights protected in other European countries? An overview.

stories.title: Dramatic California beach rescue after powerful waves hit Santa Cruz
stories.summary: A 16-year-old California lifeguard rescued a 10-year-old boy from powerful waves at Santa Cruz's Seabright State Beach in a dramatic ocean rescue.

stories.title: Syria hunts down suspects in March coastal attacks, dismantles IS cells in Aleppo
stories.summary: Security forces lured a militia commander accused of leading one of the March 2025 assault units into an ambush near Jableh, killing him and a second suspect in an exchange of fire. IS cells were separately dismantled in Aleppo and al-Bab.

stories.title: Navas del Rey residents return after Spain wildfire evacuation
stories.summary: Residents returned to Navas del Rey after Spain's wildfires, finding burned homes and scorched gardens as firefighters continued battling nearby blazes.
